home.title: Automate Telegram Notifications with Cloudflare Workers
home.subtitle: Deploy isolated edge workers to your personal Cloudflare account in 1-click. Securely dispatch alerts, webhook triggers, and channel broadcasts with Argon2 security.
home.feature1Desc: Top-tier password security with OWASP Argon2id, and hardware-grade AES-256-GCM encryption for all sensitive tokens.
home.feature2Desc: Automated provisioning directly into your own Cloudflare account using official Cloudflare REST APIs.
home.feature3Desc: Effortlessly broadcast markdown reports and structured crash logs to your channels via custom webhooks.

docs.guide1Title: 1. How to get Cloudflare Account ID & API Token
docs.guide1Step1: Log in to the Cloudflare Dashboard at dash.cloudflare.com.
docs.guide1Step2: Go to Workers & Pages in the left sidebar. Look at the right sidebar to copy your 32-character Account ID.
docs.guide1Step3: Click your profile icon (top right) ➔ My Profile ➔ API Tokens.
docs.guide1Step4: Click Create Token ➔ choose Edit Cloudflare Workers template (or Custom Token).
docs.guide1Step6: Paste both into the Cloudflare Workers tab in this dashboard and click Verify & Save Credentials.
docs.guide2Step1: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather. Send /newbot and follow instructions to get your token.
docs.guide2Step2: Add your Bot Token in the Telegram Bots tab in this dashboard.
docs.guide2Step3: Add your bot to your target channel or group as an Administrator with 'Post Messages' rights.
docs.guide2Step4: Link the channel in the dashboard using its handle (e.g. @mychannel) or numeric ID (e.g. -1001234567890).
docs.guide3Desc: All passwords and tokens are isolated in local files and strictly excluded from git version control via .gitignore.
